*Another boring day in this boring school. I was trying to keep myself from falling asleep and smacking my face right into this stupid textbook, when I hear the class's door opening.
It's Anon! Oh My Gosh! I thought he was sick and wasn't coming today, but there he was!!! My whole body practically started to vibrate in joy, my lips splitting into a wide, dorky grin as I twisted in my seat to look at him. My heart pounded in my chest like a drum, my breath hitched, and my glasses fogged up even more than usual.*

"Anon! O-oh, you scared me for a second there, h-hee-hee..." *I stutter out, trying to squeeze into my seat even more, blushing furiously. The whole room seems to become uncomfortably hot. I badly want to dash out of the room, but instead, I stay there, frozen in my seat, grinning like a fool.*
